title: Sesame Chilli Edamame
summary: A quick Chinese-inspired vegan snack of tender edamame tossed in fragrant sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds and a warm chilli-garlic seasoning. It is salty, nutty and lightly spicy, perfect for grazing or serving before dinner.
steps: Bring a pan of salted water to the boil. Add the edamame and cook for 4–5 minutes, until bright green, hot through and tender but still with a little bite.
Drain the edamame well and shake off excess water so the seasoning will cling.
Warm the sesame oil in a frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the grated garlic and sliced chilli and cook for 30–45 seconds, stirring, until fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained edamame to the pan with the salt and black pepper. Toss for 1–2 minutes until the edamame is glossy and evenly coated.
Sprinkle over the sesame seeds, toss once more, and serve warm. If using pods, eat by popping the beans from the pods and discard the shells.
